label: Shopify
why: There's no Shopify connector yet: a worker can't sign in to your store, or read or change its products, inventory, orders, pages or settings.

choices.label: Products and inventory
choices.know: Products and inventory come from a CSV exported in Shopify admin (Products → Export). The worker edits that file; the person imports it back (Products → Import).
choices.unsupported: Changing products or stock in the live store (needs the Shopify Admin API).

choices.label: Orders
choices.know: Orders come from a CSV exported in Shopify admin (Orders → Export), for analysis.
choices.unsupported: Reading or changing orders in the store itself (needs the Shopify Admin API).

choices.label: Theme and storefront code
choices.know: The theme's code (Liquid, sections, assets) is in the project folder, e.g. pulled with Shopify CLI; the person pushes and publishes it.

choices.label: Pages, blog posts and navigation
choices.unsupported: Editing store pages, blog posts or navigation (needs the Shopify Admin API).

questions.label: Review
questions.text: Whatever it changes is a file in a folder: you review it, then import or publish it in Shopify yourself. Nothing reaches the live store from here.

relations.why: Builder.io can manage the content of a headless Shopify storefront; it isn't needed for products, orders or the theme.
